case_studies.author: Callista Arden
case_studies.number_label: reviews, from a start of about 70 sales
case_studies.start: A new author with about 70 sales, mostly from friends and family, and no experience of book marketing.
case_studies.work: We placed the book in email promotions and reader newsletters suited to its audience. When the first campaign worked, we ran it again.
case_studies.result: The book reached 560 reviews after the first campaign, and 1,800 reviews after the second.

case_studies.author: Kit Rose
case_studies.start: A published book with fewer than 30 reviews.
case_studies.work: We found book clubs and reading groups suited to the book, introduced it to their organisers and coordinated the discussions.
case_studies.result: The book went from under 30 reviews to more than 200 within two months.

case_studies.author: Christina Rozelle
case_studies.start: A published book that was not reaching the readers it was written for.
case_studies.work: We audited and fixed the book’s Amazon listing, then promoted it to readers on Goodreads.
case_studies.result: The book sold more than 90 copies in a single month.

case_studies.author: Catherine J. Mottier
case_studies.plain: Book formatting, Amazon optimisation and email promotion
case_studies.number_label: reviews for Bicéphale, up from about 30
case_studies.start: Catherine’s French thriller Bicéphale was already published, but the book still needed work before it could compete. It had about 30 reviews.
case_studies.work: We formatted the book professionally and republished it, optimised its Amazon listing, then ran an early launch email promotion to targeted readers. We also built Catherine’s author website, catherine.halcyonliterary.com.
case_studies.result: Bicéphale grew from about 30 reviews to more than 300, and the book is still finding readers today.

case_studies.author: Véronique Elyotrisky
case_studies.plain: Targeted reader promotion and an author website
case_studies.number_label: novels, now with a home of their own online
case_studies.start: Véronique, a novelist from Normandy, had three novels with her publisher, Bookélis, a crime novel and a two-volume historical saga, but almost no presence online and nowhere for readers to find her.
case_studies.work: Working alongside her publisher, we brought her books to targeted readers and drove sales through her purchase links. We then built her a professional author website, veronique.halcyonliterary.com, with a page for each book, a shop for signed copies and her book fair dates.
case_studies.result: Her books reached new, targeted readers, and anyone who hears about her novels now has one place to discover all three and order a signed copy directly from her.
